title: docs(blog): the context-window post's Todo and showcase sizes are stale — ~14.5k and ~101k by its own method now measure ~23.9k and ~173.8k, so "leaves half a modern context window free" is false
body:
Filing gate ① — a `finding`: a published page states a measurement that is wrong on `main`. reach: the docs-site blog page `content/blog/context-window-is-the-constraint.mdx`, measured with the method that produced its own figures (below).

## What is wrong

The post (dated 2026-07-17) says, one paragraph below its example-CRM table (line 49 at `origin/main` `8cbe255e`):

> The Todo example is ~14.5k tokens. The kitchen-sink showcase app — which … 83 files of it … is ~101k. Even that one, the maximalist case, leaves half a modern context window …

The post does not state how tokens were estimated. The method was recovered on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22248 (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22267): **bytes of the non-test `.ts` files under the example's `src/`, divided by 4**. At the tree the figures were written on (`a6058728de00816279204adb6579ba6797a156e0`, read through the GitHub trees API) it reproduces all three of the post's numbers exactly:

| example | files | bytes | ÷ 4 | the post says |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| `app-crm` | 31 | 63,993 | 15,998 | ~16,000 |
| `app-todo` | 25 | 58,255 | 14,564 | ~14.5k |
| `app-showcase` | 83 | 405,447 | 101,362 | ~101k |

The same count at `origin/main` `8cbe255e` (`git ls-tree` + `git show`, files ending `.ts` and not `.test.ts`):

| example | files | bytes | ÷ 4 |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `app-todo` | 27 | 95,787 | ~23.9k |
| `app-showcase` | 91 | 695,310 | ~173.8k |

So the showcase now takes about 87% of a 200k-token window, and the sentence "leaves half a modern context window" is false, not just imprecise. The CRM row of the same post is corrected by PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22267; these two figures and the sentence built on them were outside that card ("nothing else on the pages changes").

## Who acts

The `domain:devx` lane (`content/**`), after triage grades it. The open question for the grade: the post is dated, and the "half a window" sentence is part of its argument, so a numbers-only fix changes what the post claims. objectstack-ai/objectstack#22248 recorded that "whether that post gets a fuller rewrite is a separate maintainer decision"; this card is the place to make it.

- "context window blog post showcase example ~101k tokens Todo ~14.5k leaves half a context window free stale": 1 hit (#7709, unrelated).
- "context-window-is-the-constraint example app size token figures drift app-showcase app-todo": 0 hits.
